$comment: Brand presets (owner, F7d): starting points for the four numbered brand colours, spread across hue and mood. Each is data: a name, its mood, and a brand block in the colour-config/2 shape (colours by slot, accent). tools/colour.mjs --check applies each over colour.config.json and holds every contrast pair in light and dark at standard and more contrast, so choosing one never breaks contrast. Order is the menu's order.

presets.name: Ocean
presets.mood: Calm and trustworthy: deep teal with sky and a coral spark.

presets.name: Forest
presets.mood: Grounded and natural: pine green, ochre and stone.

presets.name: Sunset
presets.mood: Warm and energetic: amber leads the brand, rose carries the actions.

presets.name: Berry
presets.mood: Bold and playful: raspberry and grape.

presets.name: Citrus
presets.mood: Fresh and bright: lemon and lime as identity, teal for actions they're too light to carry.

presets.name: Graphite
presets.mood: Quiet and professional: one slate blue-grey, nothing else.

presets.name: Electric
presets.mood: Vivid and digital: all four colours, violet first.

presets.name: Royal
presets.mood: Classic and confident: navy with a gold accent mark.

presets.name: Terracotta
presets.mood: Earthy and handmade: fired clay, olive and sand.
